title:
Why the bank
*said no*
caption:
You earn $10,000 a month. The bank just said no. 🏦

It's not your salary. It's your other loans. TDSR caps all repayments at 55% of income, and HDB or EC loans also face a 30% MSR.

Know someone buying a car and a house? Send this to them 📲

lines.say: You are a buyer earning ten thousand a month. The bank just said no.
lines.cap: you earn $10K a month. *the bank just said no*

lines.say: The problem isn't your salary. It's your other loans.
lines.cap: the problem isn't your salary. *it's your other loans*

lines.say: Banks use TDSR. All loan repayments, max fifty five percent of income.
lines.cap: banks use TDSR. all repayments, *max 55% of income*

lines.say: Car loan. Personal loan. They all count.
lines.cap: car loan, personal loan. *they all count*

lines.say: Buying HDB or EC? Home loan alone, max thirty percent of income.
lines.cap: buying HDB or EC? home loan alone, *max 30%*

lines.say: So clear other loans before you apply.
lines.cap: so *clear other loans* before you apply

lines.say: Know someone buying a car and a house? Send this to them.
lines.cap: know someone buying a car and a house? *send this to them*
